summary: Ultra-thin MoO3 films were fabricated on granular Au substrates using PE-ALD at 250 °C with C12H30N4Mo as the molybdenum precursor and O2 plasma as the oxygen source. The films showed crystalline structure confirmed by Raman, FTIR, and XPS. The MoO3-based sensors demonstrated wide linear range for hydrazine detection.
evidence: HIGHLIGHTS • Ultra-thin MoO 3 ﬁlm over granular Au substrate is fabricated by PE-ALD at 250 °C. • C12H30N4Mo and O2 plasma are used as molybdenum precursor and oxygen source. • The crystalline structure of MoO 3 nanoﬁlm is confirmed by Raman, FTIR and XPS. • The MoO3-based sensor shows wide linear range of 0.2 μM– 1200 μM towards N2H4.
